description: Source file implementing functions and classes for managing oblivious HTTP header key configurations, including serialization, parsing, validation, and support for different cryptographic algorithms.

classes.name: ObliviousHttpHeaderKeyConfig
classes.description: Class representing configuration for oblivious HTTP header keys, including cryptographic parameters and serialization/parsing methods.

methods.name: CheckKemId
methods.description: Checks if the provided KEM ID is supported and returns the corresponding EVP_HPKE_KEM object.

methods.name: CheckKdfId
methods.description: Checks if the provided KDF ID is supported and returns the corresponding EVP_HPKE_KDF object.

methods.name: CheckAeadId
methods.description: Checks if the provided AEAD ID is supported and returns the corresponding EVP_HPKE_AEAD object.

methods.name: ObliviousHttpHeaderKeyConfig::Create
methods.description: Creates a new ObliviousHttpHeaderKeyConfig instance after validating the provided parameters.

methods.name: ObliviousHttpHeaderKeyConfig::ValidateKeyConfig
methods.description: Validates the cryptographic parameters of the configuration.

methods.name: ObliviousHttpHeaderKeyConfig::GetHpkeKem
methods.description: Returns the EVP_HPKE_KEM object for the current configuration.

methods.name: ObliviousHttpHeaderKeyConfig::GetHpkeKdf
methods.description: Returns the EVP_HPKE_KDF object for the current configuration.

methods.name: ObliviousHttpHeaderKeyConfig::GetHpkeAead
methods.description: Returns the EVP_HPKE_AEAD object for the current configuration.

methods.name: ObliviousHttpHeaderKeyConfig::SerializeRecipientContextInfo
methods.description: Serializes the recipient context information into a string.

methods.name: ObliviousHttpHeaderKeyConfig::ParseOhttpPayloadHeader
methods.description: Parses the OHTTP payload header from a string view.

methods.name: ObliviousHttpHeaderKeyConfig::ParseOhttpPayloadHeader
methods.description: Parses the OHTTP payload header from a QuicheDataReader.

methods.name: ObliviousHttpHeaderKeyConfig::ParseKeyIdFromObliviousHttpRequestPayload
methods.description: Extracts the key ID from an oblivious HTTP request payload.

methods.name: ObliviousHttpHeaderKeyConfig::SerializeOhttpPayloadHeader
methods.description: Serializes the OHTTP payload header.

methods.name: KeyLength
methods.description: Returns the length of the public key for a given KEM ID.

methods.name: SerializeOhttpKeyWithPublicKey
methods.description: Serializes an OHTTP key with its public key and configurations.

methods.name: GetDebugStringForFailedKeyConfig
methods.description: Generates a debug string for a failed key configuration.

methods.name: StoreKeyConfigIfValid
methods.description: Validates and stores a key configuration if valid.

methods.name: ObliviousHttpKeyConfigs::ParseConcatenatedKeys
methods.description: Parses concatenated key configurations into an ObliviousHttpKeyConfigs object.

methods.name: ObliviousHttpKeyConfigs::Create
methods.description: Creates an ObliviousHttpKeyConfigs object from a set of key configs.

methods.name: ObliviousHttpKeyConfigs::Create
methods.description: Creates an ObliviousHttpKeyConfigs object from a single key config and public key.

methods.name: ObliviousHttpKeyConfigs::GenerateConcatenatedKeys
methods.description: Generates concatenated key configuration string from internal data.

methods.name: ObliviousHttpKeyConfigs::PreferredConfig
methods.description: Returns the preferred key configuration.

methods.name: ObliviousHttpKeyConfigs::GetPublicKeyForId
methods.description: Retrieves the public key for a given key ID.

methods.name: ObliviousHttpKeyConfigs::ReadSingleKeyConfig
methods.description: Reads a single key configuration from a data reader.
